notes.title: Identify the time-of-flight sensor
notes.body: Yvel has a time-of-flight device. Record its exact model and board markings before selecting a library, voltage or wiring. None of those details are verified yet.

notes.title: Document the physical build
notes.body: UNO R4 WiFi was previously reported as the board. The repository itself specifies only an Arduino-compatible board. Confirm the installed board, sensor models, strip length and power arrangement.

notes.title: Capture a bench-test record
notes.body: Record the board, library version, wiring, expected result and observed result. Keep source inspection separate from a physical test pass.

notes.title: Evaluate non-blocking animation
notes.body: The current animations use delay(25), so loop() does not poll sensors while they play. A non-blocking design could be evaluated later; the original sketch is preserved.
